conviction_note: abs_move 7.0 (event-implied 6.57%, last confirmed print 2026-08-18 fell 12.73%) times a slight up-lean, p_up 53: the EPS bar was cut about 40% in 30 days, AI Cloud Infra laps an easy RMB4.2bn comp and the stock sits 1.5% off its 52-week low. Against that, management already told the market both the cloud acceleration and the ad pressure, the revenue bar has two sources that disagree, and the name fell 12.7% the last time revenue missed, so the lean stays near 50. The findings sum (+1.05) is larger than the scaled number (+0.42) because it adds many small positives that each depend on guidance the market has already heard.
bar: Revenue: Futu/consensus CNY30.62bn for Q3 2026, down 1.77% YoY (search snippet only; the futunn page did not render: https://news.futunn.com/en/post/1004095195/earnings-preview-baidu-to-report-financial-results-pre-market-on). Zacks has $4.61bn (+5.18% YoY) and EPS $0.85 (down 45.5% YoY, cut 40.1% in the last 30 days): https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/BIDU-Q/pressreleases/8804035/baidu-to-report-q3-earnings-what-s-in-store-for-the-stock/ (2026-11-12). The two revenue bars do not agree in growth terms. Converting Zacks' USD figure, a currency or basis difference is the likely cause. Sell-side core forecasts: SPDB International puts core revenue at RMB24.7bn (+0.2%), AI Cloud Infra at RMB7.98bn (+90% YoY) and online marketing at RMB11.8bn (-23%) (https://m.gelonghui.com/news/5340773, 2026-10-30). Citi puts core at about -1.5% YoY (https://uanalyze.com.tw/articles/8221453668, 2026-08-19). The company gives no numerical guide, only qualitative H2 commentary. Because the revenue bar cannot be pinned to two agreeing sources, every finding that depends on the bar is capped small.
positioning_check: Short interest 12.2m shares, about 3.6% of shares outstanding, 6.01 days to cover (FINRA settlement 2026-10-30, https://equibles.com/stocks/bidu/shortinterest, via the sweep row). This is not a crowded short. Skew is +1.21 vol points (25d put minus call), which is close to balanced, and the baseline reads priced_direction_lean 'balanced'. Put/call open interest is 0.62. The stock is $77.54, 1.49% above its 52-week low and 52.3% below its high, down 5.29% over 5 days and 3.24% over 20 days. On 2026-11-12 it fell 3.4% intraday on a US rule blocking remote chip access (https://sg.finance.yahoo.com/news/baidu-stocks-fall-3-41-114912321.html). The HK line closed at HK$74.20 on 2026-11-13, down 3.39%.

findings.finding: The Zacks EPS consensus for Q3 2026 is $0.85, down 45.5% YoY and cut 40.1% in the last 30 days, so the profit bar fell sharply in the weeks before the print. Zacks notes Q2 capex nearly tripled to RMB11.4bn and that rising depreciation could pressure margins. Over the last four quarters BIDU beat EPS twice and missed twice, with an average surprise of -0.71%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (2026-08-18): the revenue miss plus a 68% net income drop sent the ADS down 12.73%, per the law-firm notice https://www.webull.com/news/15668355038790656. Q3 2025: revenue beat a -8% expectation and the ADS was about -1% premarket (https://stocktwits.com/news-articles/markets/equity/baidu-swings-to-net-loss-ad-slump-drags-revenue-down-7-despite-cloud-gains/cLPNzvWRE72). Beats on EPS have not been bought on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the cut is public, and the stock fell to near its 52-week low as estimates came down. What is not priced is the easier hurdle itself. If the market expected a further miss below the cut number, the skew would be put-heavy instead of balanced (+1.21). The revenue bar has two inconsistent sources, so this finding is capped small.
findings.independence: SPDB International's preview cuts core adjusted operating profit to RMB1.53bn (https://m.gelonghui.com/news/5340773). That is a different source pointing the same way, a low profit bar.

findings.finding: AI Cloud Infra laps an easy comparison. Q3 2025 AI Cloud Infra revenue was RMB4.2bn (+33%), and Q2 2026 was RMB7.3bn (+50%) with GPU cloud +283%. A flat sequential quarter would therefore print about +74% YoY. SPDB International expects RMB7.98bn, +90% YoY and +9.3% QoQ. Management guided H2 AI Cloud Infra growth to 'remain strong ... with potential for further acceleration'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: AI Cloud Infra +50% and GPU cloud +283% did not stop a -12.73% day when total revenue and the AI-powered business (down 8% QoQ) disappointed. Cloud strength has been sold when total revenue declines.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline acceleration is mechanical and inside the company's own qualitative guide. A sell-side preview already carries +90%. If this were unpriced, the previews would not already model a ~90% headline. The only unpriced part is the gap between the sequential number and SPDBI's +9.3% QoQ.
findings.independence: Q2 2026 figures and the H2 guide are from https://thenextweb.com/news/baidu-q2-2026-earnings-revenue-fifth-drop-ai-cloud (2026-08-18) and https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/BIDU-Q/pressreleases/8804035/baidu-to-report-q3-earnings-what-s-in-store-for-the-stock/. The SPDBI forecast is from https://m.gelonghui.com/news/5340773. All of them rest on the company's own disclosures.

findings.finding: Online marketing remains the drag. It was RMB13.1bn in Q2 2026 (-19% YoY), and legacy business fell 23%. The CFO said 'we expect our advertising business to remain under pressure in the second half', and Baidu is prioritising AI-search answer quality over monetisation. SPDBI models Q3 online marketing at RMB11.8bn, -23% YoY against RMB15.3bn in Q3 2025. That is a further sequential fall of about 10%. To net this out, AI Cloud Infra would need to grow about RMB3.5bn YoY to offset a ~RMB3.5bn ad decline. SPDBI's model has roughly that, hence core revenue at +0.2%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This is the line the stock traded on at Q2 2026 (-12.73%), and it is the subject of the securities class action over the Nov 2025 to Aug 2026 class period.
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced. The decline is inside management's own H2 guide and in every preview. Only a fall deeper than -23% YoY, or a softer ad outlook for Q4, would be new. The near-balanced skew suggests the market does not expect a fresh shock.
findings.independence: SPDBI's -23% is from https://m.gelonghui.com/news/5340773. The Zacks segment notes (https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/BIDU-Q/pressreleases/8804035/baidu-to-report-q3-earnings-what-s-in-store-for-the-stock/) agree, and both rest on the same company guide.

findings.finding: Apollo Go should rebound from a regulator-hit Q2. Fully driverless rides fell from about 3.2m in Q1 2026 to about 1m in Q2 after the March 31 Wuhan mass stall and the national freeze on new permits. China resumed issuing robotaxi licences on 2026-07-23, and Apollo Go cars were seen back on Wuhan streets from early July. Q3 ride volume should therefore recover, which Zacks also expects.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Apollo Go news has moved the stock as a sentiment line. It fell about 3% on 2026-04-29 on the permit freeze (https://www.thestandard.com.hk/innovation/article/330641/China-suspends-new-autonomous-vehicle-permits-after-Baidu-outage-Bloomberg-News-reports), and Nov 2025 ride milestones moved it about 5%. Revenue impact is immaterial against RMB30bn of quarterly revenue.
findings.why_not_priced: The resumption has been public since July. What is not public is the Q3 ride count: no number has been disclosed since Q2's ~1m. A figure back near 3m+ would be a visible positive datapoint on the call. If it were already priced, sell-side previews would carry a ride number, and the ones found do not.
findings.independence: The Q1 and Q2 ride counts come from a Chinese aggregation of company disclosures (https://m.gelonghui.com/live/2163890 in the search result set). Zacks says 'expected to recover after Q2 rides were limited to about one million' (https://www.theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/BIDU-Q/pressreleases/8804035/baidu-to-report-q3-earnings-what-s-in-store-for-the-stock/).

findings.finding: A US Commerce rule blocking Chinese firms' remote access to advanced AI chips in overseas data centres is reported to be finalising and could be announced this month. BIDU fell 3.4% on 2026-11-12 on the report, less than Alibaba's ~8%. The rule text has not been published.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell 3.41% on the report (2026-11-12). Baidu's smaller drop than Alibaba's suggests less exposure, since Baidu runs its own Kunlun chips.
findings.why_not_priced: The report itself is priced through the Nov 12 fall. Final text inside the window would be a second step. Management may also use the call to frame Kunlun self-sufficiency as an advantage, which could flip the sign. This is a macro-to-company proxy and is sized small.

findings.finding: The stock is washed out into the print but not crowded short. It is 1.49% above its 52-week low, 52% below its high, down about 48% YTD and down 5.3% in 5 days. Short interest is 3.6% of shares with 6 days to cover, and skew is near balanced at +1.21. Consensus target is ~$134.6 against $77.6 spot.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 also came after a >12% five-day drop into the print, and the reaction was about -1% premarket on a revenue beat. A low base did not produce a bounce then.
findings.why_not_priced: This is positioning, not information. The run-down reflects known causes: the Q2 miss, the ad decline, the class action and the chip rule. Upside asymmetry would show as cheaper puts; skew is roughly flat, so the market is not paying for further downside. Sized small because the drawdown has explanations.
findings.independence: Short interest is from https://equibles.com/stocks/bidu/shortinterest (2026-10-30). The tape figures are from the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: Baidu has a US$5bn buyback authorised through 2028 (announced 2026-02-04) alongside its first dividend policy. Only about $259m was repurchased in H1 2026, against RMB283.1bn of cash and investments, and the stock is at a 52-week low. An acceleration or a new capital-return statement on the call would be a positive.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Feb 2026 buyback and dividend announcement lifted the stock (https://rallies.ai/news/baidu-rallies-as-first-ever-cash-dividend-and-5b-buyback-plan-lift-sentiment, size undated).
findings.why_not_priced: Nothing indicates a step-up, and capex that tripled with FCF around -RMB8bn argues against one. This is an option on a call statement, not a fact, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The $259m H1 execution and RMB283.1bn cash figure are from https://thenextweb.com/news/baidu-q2-2026-earnings-revenue-fifth-drop-ai-cloud (2026-08-18).

findings.finding: The GAAP comparison is easy. Q3 2025 posted a RMB11.2bn net loss on asset writedowns, so Q3 2026 GAAP net income will probably compare favourably YoY, unless there is a new impairment. Q2 2026 net income was already down 68%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 2025 impairment-driven loss was met with about -1% premarket, so the market looked through it.
findings.why_not_priced: It is below operating income with no path to the guide, so it is sized at a fraction. The risk runs both ways: a fresh writedown on legacy assets is possible after a 68% Q2 profit drop.

findings.finding: Kunlunxin, the AI chip unit (Baidu ~57.7% owner), filed confidentially for a HK listing on 2026-01-01 and completed STAR Market tutoring filing on 2026-05-07. Reported target valuations range from RMB100bn to US$50bn. No hearing or acceptance has been found since. A timeline update on the call is a possible catalyst.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Baidu shares rose on the January IPO filing news (https://www.techcentral.ie/baidu-share-rises-due-to-planned-ipo-of-ai-chip-division-kunlunxin/).
findings.why_not_priced: Known since January. Only a dated milestone would be new, and no document says one is coming. Sized as a small option.
findings.independence: The STAR tutoring filing is reported by 21st Century Business Herald (https://www.sfccn.com/2026/5-8/xMMDE0NDlfMjE0MDYxMQ.html).

findings.finding: Model line-up churn. On 2026-11-12 Baidu launched ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview as an open-weight model priced at RMB1/4 per million input/output tokens, plus a Token Exchange marketplace, and said daily active agents grew from 5,000 to 37,000. A single secondary source says ERNIE 5.0 was switched off on Qianfan on 2026-10-29, with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash named as the replacement.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured reaction to model launches on this name in the period searched.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and pre-print. The launch suggests constructive model-competitiveness commentary on the call, while the cheap token pricing and the retirement of ERNIE 5.0 cut the other way. Net zero.
findings.independence: The ERNIE 5.0 retirement claim is from https://www.secondtalent.com/resources/every-ernie-ai-model-explained-compared/ (secondary, unverified).

findings.finding: iQIYI, which Baidu consolidates, reports Q3 2026 on the same morning (2026-11-16 bmo). Its Q2 2026 revenue was RMB6.29bn (-5% YoY), against a Q3 2025 base of RMB6.68bn. It remains a revenue drag of roughly RMB0.3-0.5bn YoY on the consolidated number.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Zacks lists iQIYI as an expected drag. No separate measured BIDU reaction to iQIYI misses was found.
findings.why_not_priced: It is in the consolidated consensus. Only a deviation in iQIYI's own print would matter, and it lands at the same time as Baidu's.
findings.independence: The Q2 2026 iQIYI revenue is from the SEC 6-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001722608/000119312526356051/d926532dex991.htm.

findings.finding: The securities class action (SDNY, class period 2025-11-18 to 2026-08-17) alleges Baidu did not disclose that total revenue was likely to decline. The lead-plaintiff deadline was 2026-11-13. Management may be more conservative in trend disclosure on this call as a result.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured reaction to the law-firm notices.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public and well advertised, with no economic effect inside the window. Filed for completeness.

outside_window.finding: ERNIE 5.5 Flash open weights are due by 2026-11-25, after the exit window.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Earnings preview saying Q3 revenue expected -1.86% with a 32.15bn RMB consensus
rejected_candidates.detail: The article is dated 2026-08-11 and previews the June 2026 quarter, not Q3 2026, so it is not this print's bar.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Bar of 30.87bn yuan revenue and 7.72 RMB adj EPS per ADS for Q3
rejected_candidates.detail: Dated 2025-11-18, so these are Q3 2025 estimates. Excluded per the date-on-URL rule.
The sweep marked baseline_history_trustworthy false: these are a 3-day cadence of non-earnings 6-Ks, not prints.

baseline_tension: Mostly agrees with a balanced skew. The slight up-lean (easier EPS bar, mechanical cloud acceleration, washed-out tape) goes with the 20-day drawdown as a contrarian read, but this name sold off 12.7% on its last revenue miss, so the lean is kept close to 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (verify the bar): the revenue bar has two inconsistent sources (Zacks +5.18% USD vs Futu -1.77% RMB), so the EPS-bar-cut finding was capped from +0.6 to +0.4.

Rule 6 (inside guidance): AI Cloud acceleration is inside management's 'potential for further acceleration' guide, cut from +0.5 to +0.3. The ad decline is inside the 'remain under pressure' guide, cut from -0.4 to -0.2.
Rule 5 (proxy, unexplained drawdown): the chip-rule finding is macro transmission, -0.3 to -0.2. The washed-out positioning finding rests on a drawdown with known causes, +0.5 to +0.3.
Rule 2 (one-offs): the GAAP-comp finding is below operating income, +0.1 to +0.05.
Rule 9 (net of the rest): Apollo Go is immaterial to revenue, +0.3 to +0.2.
Capital return and Kunlunxin are options on call statements with no document of a step: buyback +0.3 to +0.2, Kunlunxin +0.2 to +0.1.

Rule 1 and the untrustworthy-history lesson: rebuilt the base rate from confirmed prints (Q2 2026 -12.73%, Q3 2025 ~-1% premarket). Beats have not been paid, so p_up moved 54 to 53. abs_move stays 7.0.
print_vs_bar moved from +0.5 to +0.3 because the bar is unresolved.
